backgroundBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background for Everthread mobile life-simulation location page. Create one original polished anime / modern manhwa environment painting, portrait 1024x1536 (2:3). Clean precise architectural line art, restrained soft cel shading, grounded inviting modern small-town design, intricate but readable, crisp shapes, atmospheric depth, beautiful cinematic lighting, no people. Consistent Everthread art direction: desaturated forest teal architecture, honey-gold light, warm cream details; local colors as appropriate. Eye level with very slightly elevated three-quarter view; believable perspective. Compose for a phone: upper 12% quiet atmospheric header space, recognizable secondary interaction areas between y=28% and 60%; foreground between x=15–85%, y=65–88% is clear floor or paving for a separately composited object. No interface, buttons, icons, captions, lettering, logos, watermarks, or legible signs. One cohesive image; never a collage or grid.

propBase: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a separate compositable object sprite for the Everthread anime game. Generate a single isolated object on a genuinely transparent alpha background, PNG, square 1024x1024. No opaque background, floor plane, wall, checkerboard drawing, text, logo, border, or watermark. Original clean anime / manhwa painted game prop, precise line work, soft cel shading, grounded modern materials in dark forest teal, honey oak, warm cream and gold. Front three-quarter perspective, viewer slightly above tabletop height, gentle warm light from upper left. Entire object and its feet visible, centered with 8% transparent breathing space around silhouette, subtle self shading, no detached cast shadow. It will be composited into a portrait environment; draw only the specified prop.
